text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Wellesley Street East, City Council approval of this report is required. Aragon Properties Ltd., is constructing a 28-storey residential condominium building at 81 Wellesley Street East. The site is located the south side of Wellesley Street East, between Church Street and Jarvis Street. The developer originally requested a closure for 26 months but Transportation Services is seeking authority for 12 months at this time. Staff will review the need to extend the duration of the construction staging area and seek authority from City Council if necessary. Although Transportation Services is technically requesting approval to close the sidewalk, bike lane and a portion of the eastbound curb lane in their current location, on the south side of Wellesley Street East to accommodate construction staging operations, traffic…

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the closure of the south sidewalk on Wellesley Street East, between a point 34 metres east of Church Street and a point 19.5 metres further east, from May 1, 2018 to May 1, 2019. 2. City Council approve the closure of the bike lane and a portion of the eastbound curb lane on the south side of Wellesley Street East, between a point 11 metres east of Church Street and a point 68.5 meters further east, from May 1, 2018 to May 1, 2019. 3. City Council direct the applicant to post a 24-hour monitored construction hotline number on the hoarding board, which must be prominently placed and legible from 20 metres and on all elevations from the construction site. 4.
